name: otterbridge-whatsapp-mcp
description: Read and act on your WhatsApp from your AI assistant — 174 tools for chats, contacts, groups, channels and media, with human-like send pacing.
long_description:
Connects the WhatsApp account you already use (via WhatsApp Web) and exposes 174 tools: read chats, contacts, groups and channels; send text, media, polls, locations and stickers; react, reply, edit, forward and manage groups.

Outbound messages are paced to resemble human sending — a typing indicator sized to the message, randomised delays, per-chat cooldowns, and ceilings of 40/hour, 200/day and 5 new chats per hour.

Every tool carries MCP ToolAnnotations: 69 read-only tools your assistant can call freely, and 14 irreversible ones it is told to confirm with you first.

UNOFFICIAL CLIENT. This drives WhatsApp Web in a headless browser. It is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta, using it may violate WhatsApp's terms, and accounts can be banned. Requires Chrome (or Chromium/Edge) installed, and linking a device by QR once.

session_name.title: Session name
session_name.description: Names the linked device and its local session folder. Change it to run a second account.

chrome_path.title: Chrome path (optional)
chrome_path.description: Leave blank to auto-detect Chrome, Chromium or Edge. Set only if detection fails.

license_key.title: Licence key (optional)
license_key.description: Only for a machine nobody can open a browser on, or a key issued for CI. Most people should leave this blank and ask their assistant to "sign in to OtterBridge" instead — new accounts get a free trial.

data_path.title: Session folder (optional)
data_path.description: Where the linked WhatsApp session is stored. Leave blank for the standard per-user location (%LOCALAPPDATA%\OtterBridge\whatsapp-mcp on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/OtterBridge/whatsapp-mcp on macOS). Set an absolute path to keep it elsewhere. This folder is a credential — do not put it on a shared drive.

tools.name: whatsapp_state
tools.description: Get connection state: Current WhatsApp Web state (CONNECTED, OPENING, PAIRING…). [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_wweb_version
tools.description: Get WhatsApp Web version: Which web build the injected page is running. Useful when the library breaks after a WhatsApp update. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_client_info
tools.description: Get client info: Logged-in account: wid, pushname, platform. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_battery
tools.description: Get battery info: Phone battery (legacy; often empty on multi-device). [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_set_display_name
tools.description: Set display name: Changes your WhatsApp profile name.

tools.name: whatsapp_set_status
tools.description: Set About / status text: Sets the "About" line on your profile.

tools.name: whatsapp_set_profile_pic
tools.description: Set profile picture: Uploads a new profile photo from a local path or URL.

tools.name: whatsapp_delete_profile_pic
tools.description: Delete profile picture: Removes your profile photo. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_set_device_name
tools.description: Set linked device name: Renames this session in Linked Devices.

tools.name: whatsapp_presence_available
tools.description: Go online: Marks the account as available (drives "online" for contacts).

tools.name: whatsapp_presence_unavailable
tools.description: Go offline: Marks the account unavailable.

tools.name: whatsapp_auto_dl_photos
tools.description: Auto-download photos: Toggle automatic photo download.

tools.name: whatsapp_auto_dl_audio
tools.description: Auto-download audio: Toggle automatic audio download.

tools.name: whatsapp_auto_dl_video
tools.description: Auto-download video: Toggle automatic video download.

tools.name: whatsapp_auto_dl_docs
tools.description: Auto-download documents: Toggle automatic document download.

tools.name: whatsapp_background_sync
tools.description: Set background sync: Controls whether WhatsApp Web syncs in the background.

tools.name: whatsapp_pairing_code
tools.description: Request pairing code: Alternative to QR: links via an 8-char code typed on the phone. Include country code, digits only.

tools.name: whatsapp_cancel_pairing
tools.description: Cancel pairing code: Aborts an in-flight pairing-code request.

tools.name: whatsapp_reset_state
tools.description: Reset state: Forces the page back to a clean connection state. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_contacts_all
tools.description: List all contacts: Every contact known to the account. Can be thousands. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_contact_by_id
tools.description: Get contact by id: Full contact object including business fields. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_number_id
tools.description: Resolve number → WhatsApp id: Returns the serialized WID, or null if the number is not on WhatsApp. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_is_registered
tools.description: Is number on WhatsApp?: Boolean registration check. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_formatted_number
tools.description: Format number: WhatsApp’s own international formatting. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_country_code
tools.description: Get country code: Extracts the country calling code. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_profile_pic
tools.description: Get profile picture URL: Returns a CDN URL, or undefined if hidden by privacy settings. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_about
tools.description: Get contact About text: The contact’s status line, privacy permitting. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_common_groups
tools.description: Groups in common: Groups you share with this contact. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_device_count
tools.description: Count linked devices: How many devices that contact has linked. 0 can mean unreachable. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_lid_and_phone
tools.description: Map LID ↔ phone number: WhatsApp’s newer LID identifiers vs classic phone JIDs. Comma-separate ids. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_blocked
tools.description: List blocked contacts: Everyone you have blocked. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_block
tools.description: Block contact: Blocks a contact. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_unblock
tools.description: Unblock contact: Unblocks a contact.

tools.name: whatsapp_save_contact
tools.description: Save / edit address book contact: Writes a contact into the WhatsApp address book.

tools.name: whatsapp_delete_contact
tools.description: Delete address book contact: Removes a saved contact. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_chats_all
tools.description: List chats: All chats, newest first. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_chat_by_id
tools.description: Get chat by id: Full chat object. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_fetch_messages
tools.description: Fetch chat history: Loads recent messages. fromMe filter optional. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_search_messages
tools.description: Search messages: Full-text search across chats (or within one). [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_pinned_messages
tools.description: Get pinned messages: Messages pinned in a chat. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_send_seen
tools.description: Mark chat as read: Sends read receipts (blue ticks) for the chat.

tools.name: whatsapp_mark_unread
tools.description: Mark chat as unread: Flags the chat unread.

tools.name: whatsapp_archive
tools.description: Archive chat: Moves the chat to Archived.

tools.name: whatsapp_unarchive
tools.description: Unarchive chat: Restores an archived chat.

tools.name: whatsapp_pin
tools.description: Pin chat: Pins to the top. WhatsApp caps this at 3.

tools.name: whatsapp_unpin
tools.description: Unpin chat: Unpins the chat.

tools.name: whatsapp_mute
tools.description: Mute chat: Mute until a date. Leave blank to mute indefinitely.

tools.name: whatsapp_unmute
tools.description: Unmute chat: Removes the mute.

tools.name: whatsapp_typing
tools.description: Show "typing…": Broadcasts the typing indicator.

tools.name: whatsapp_recording
tools.description: Show "recording audio…": Broadcasts the recording indicator.

tools.name: whatsapp_clear_state
tools.description: Clear typing/recording state: Stops the indicator.

tools.name: whatsapp_sync_history
tools.description: Request history sync: Asks the phone to push older history for a chat.

tools.name: whatsapp_clear_messages
tools.description: Clear chat messages: Deletes all messages but keeps the chat. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_delete_chat
tools.description: Delete chat: Removes the chat entirely. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_send_text
tools.description: Send text message: Plain text. Supports *bold*, _italic_, ~strike~ and monospace.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_media
tools.description: Send media (image/video/doc): From a local path or URL. Flags cover HD, GIF, document and view-once modes.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_voice
tools.description: Send voice note: Sends audio as a push-to-talk voice note (needs ffmpeg for non-ogg input).

tools.name: whatsapp_send_sticker
tools.description: Send sticker: Converts an image to a sticker, with author/pack metadata.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_location
tools.description: Send location: Pin with optional name and address.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_contact
tools.description: Send contact card: Forwards a contact as a vCard.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_poll
tools.description: Send poll: Native WhatsApp poll. Two to twelve options.

tools.name: whatsapp_poll_votes
tools.description: Get poll votes: Reads votes cast on a poll message. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_send_buttons
tools.description: Send buttons (legacy): Interactive buttons. WhatsApp has largely retired these for unofficial clients, so expect failure. Kept here to document the limit.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_list
tools.description: Send list message (legacy): Selectable list. Same retirement caveat as buttons.

tools.name: whatsapp_get_message
tools.description: Get message by id: Full message object. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_download_media
tools.description: Download message media: Returns mimetype, filename and size. The base64 body is omitted to keep the log readable. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_message_info
tools.description: Get delivery info: Per-recipient delivered/read receipts. Only works for your own messages. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_reactions
tools.description: Get message reactions: Who reacted and with what. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_mentions
tools.description: Get message mentions: Contacts mentioned in the message. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_quoted
tools.description: Get quoted message: The message this one replies to. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_reply
tools.description: Reply to a message: Sends a quoted reply.

tools.name: whatsapp_react
tools.description: React to a message: Send an emoji reaction. An empty string removes it.

tools.name: whatsapp_forward
tools.description: Forward a message: Forwards to another chat.

tools.name: whatsapp_edit
tools.description: Edit a message: Edits your own message. WhatsApp allows roughly 15 minutes.

tools.name: whatsapp_delete_msg
tools.description: Delete a message: everyone=true revokes for all; false deletes only for you. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_star
tools.description: Star message: Adds to starred messages.

tools.name: whatsapp_unstar
tools.description: Unstar message: Removes from starred.

tools.name: whatsapp_pin_msg
tools.description: Pin message: Pins in-chat for N seconds (86400 = 1 day).

tools.name: whatsapp_unpin_msg
tools.description: Unpin message: Unpins the message.

tools.name: whatsapp_groups_list
tools.description: List groups: All group chats with participant counts. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_group_info
tools.description: Get group details: Full group object including every participant and their admin flags. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_group_create
tools.description: Create group: Creates a group. Some numbers may fail to be added if their privacy settings forbid it; the result reports which.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_add
tools.description: Add participants: Adds members. Returns a per-participant status code.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_remove
tools.description: Remove participants: Kicks members. Requires admin. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_group_promote
tools.description: Promote to admin: Grants admin rights.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_demote
tools.description: Demote admin: Revokes admin rights.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_subject
tools.description: Set group name: Renames the group.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_description
tools.description: Set group description: Updates the group description.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_picture
tools.description: Set group picture: Uploads a new group icon.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_delete_picture
tools.description: Delete group picture: Removes the group icon. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_group_msgs_admins_only
tools.description: Only admins can send: Announcement mode on or off.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_info_admins_only
tools.description: Only admins can edit info: Locks name/description/icon to admins.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_add_admins_only
tools.description: Only admins can add members: Restricts who may add participants.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_invite_code
tools.description: Get invite code: Returns the code; the link is https://chat.whatsapp.com/<code>. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_group_revoke_invite
tools.description: Revoke invite link: Invalidates the old link and returns a new code. [Destructive — removes or invalidates something.]

tools.name: whatsapp_group_invite_info
tools.description: Inspect an invite code: Previews a group from its invite code without joining. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_group_accept_invite
tools.description: Join group by invite code: Joins the group and returns its id.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_requests
tools.description: List membership requests: Pending join requests for a group. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_group_approve
tools.description: Approve membership requests: Approves specific requesters, or all if left blank.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_reject
tools.description: Reject membership requests: Rejects specific requesters, or all if left blank.

tools.name: whatsapp_group_leave
tools.description: Leave group: Leaves the group. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_channels_list
tools.description: List channels: Channels (newsletters) you follow or own. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_search
tools.description: Search public channels: Directory search. Filter by country/category, or leave blank for a general listing. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_by_invite
tools.description: Get channel by invite code: Resolves a channel invite code to the channel. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_create
tools.description: Create channel: Creates a new channel you own.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe to channel: Follows a channel.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_unsubscribe
tools.description: Unsubscribe from channel: Unfollows a channel.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_send
tools.description: Send to channel: Posts a text message to a channel you own.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_messages
tools.description: Fetch channel messages: Reads recent channel posts. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_subscribers
tools.description: Get channel subscribers: Lists subscribers of a channel you own. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_subject
tools.description: Set channel name: Renames a channel you own.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_description
tools.description: Set channel description: Updates the description.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_picture
tools.description: Set channel picture: Uploads a channel icon.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_reactions
tools.description: Set channel reaction policy: Modes: ALL, BASIC, NONE.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_admin_invite
tools.description: Invite a channel admin: Sends an admin invite for a channel you own.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_admin_accept
tools.description: Accept channel admin invite: Accepts an admin invitation.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_admin_revoke
tools.description: Revoke channel admin invite: Cancels a pending admin invite. [Destructive — removes or invalidates something.]

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_admin_demote
tools.description: Demote channel admin: Removes admin rights. [Destructive — removes or invalidates something.]

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_transfer
tools.description: Transfer channel ownership: Hands the channel to another user. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_delete
tools.description: Delete channel: Permanently deletes a channel you own. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcast lists & status: Broadcast lists plus the Status feed. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_broadcast_by_id
tools.description: Get broadcast by id: A single broadcast list. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_revoke_status
tools.description: Delete a status update: Removes one of your own status posts. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_labels
tools.description: List labels: WhatsApp Business labels. Empty on a personal account. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_label_by_id
tools.description: Get label by id: A single label. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_chat_labels
tools.description: Get labels on a chat: Labels applied to one chat. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_chats_by_label
tools.description: Get chats by label: Every chat carrying a label. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_label_apply
tools.description: Add / remove labels on chats: Sets the label set for the given chats.

tools.name: whatsapp_customer_note_get
tools.description: Get customer note: Business CRM note attached to a chat. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_customer_note_set
tools.description: Set customer note: Writes the CRM note for a chat.

tools.name: whatsapp_order
tools.description: Get order from message: Reads a business order attached to an order-type message. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_payment
tools.description: Get payment from message: Reads payment details from a payment-type message. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_call_link
tools.description: Create a call link: Generates a shareable voice or video call link. Start time is required by the library (a Date); blank means now.

tools.name: whatsapp_scheduled_event_respond
tools.description: Respond to a scheduled event: Responses: going, not_going, maybe.

tools.name: whatsapp_poll_vote
tools.description: Vote on a poll: Casts your own vote on a received poll. No Client-level equivalent exists.

tools.name: whatsapp_msg_reload
tools.description: Reload message: Re-reads the message from the store; returns null if it was deleted. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_msg_chat
tools.description: Get message chat: The chat a message belongs to. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_msg_contact
tools.description: Get message sender: The contact who sent the message. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_msg_group_mentions
tools.description: Get group mentions: Groups mentioned inside a message (distinct from contact mentions). [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_msg_react
tools.description: React via message object: Message.react, the structure-level counterpart to client.sendReaction.

tools.name: whatsapp_accept_v4_invite
tools.description: Accept group v4 invite: Accepts an invite delivered as a groups_v4_invite message.

tools.name: whatsapp_edit_scheduled_event

tools.name: whatsapp_chat_archive_obj
tools.description: Archive via chat object: Chat.archive, the structure-level counterpart to client.archiveChat.

tools.name: whatsapp_chat_unarchive_obj
tools.description: Unarchive via chat object: Chat.unarchive.

tools.name: whatsapp_chat_mute_obj
tools.description: Mute via chat object: Chat.mute. Blank date mutes indefinitely.

tools.name: whatsapp_chat_unmute_obj
tools.description: Unmute via chat object: Chat.unmute.

tools.name: whatsapp_chat_mark_unread_obj
tools.description: Mark unread via chat object: Chat.markUnread.

tools.name: whatsapp_chat_contact
tools.description: Get chat contact: The contact behind a private chat. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_chat_change_labels
tools.description: Change labels via chat object: Chat.changeLabels. Business accounts only.

tools.name: whatsapp_contact_chat
tools.description: Get chat from contact: Opens (or creates) the chat for a contact. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_contact_broadcast
tools.description: Get contact status feed: The contact’s broadcast/status entry. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_mute
tools.description: Mute channel: Channel.mute.

tools.name: whatsapp_channel_unmute
tools.description: Unmute channel: Channel.unmute.

tools.name: whatsapp_media_probe
tools.description: Probe media loading: Loads a file or URL through MessageMedia without sending it, to check size and mimetype detection. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_diag_modules
tools.description: Check WhatsApp internal modules: Resolves each internal module the library needs. Anything "missing" is a candidate cause when features break after a WhatsApp update. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_diag_collections
tools.description: Inspect WAWebCollections: Lists what WAWebCollections actually exposes, and whether Chat/Msg/Contact are present with usable counts. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_diag_chat_model
tools.description: Step through getChatModel: Reproduces the library’s getChatModel one step at a time so the exact failing line is visible instead of a minified error. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_diag_raw_chat_count
tools.description: Count raw chats (bypasses getChatModel): Reads the chat collection directly. If this works while chats_all fails, the breakage is in the library’s model mapping, not in WhatsApp itself. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_diag_versions
tools.description: Version drift check: Compares the WhatsApp Web build actually loaded against the version whatsapp-web.js pins. A mismatch is the usual cause of sudden breakage. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_diag_chat_sweep
tools.description: Sweep getChatModel over every chat: Calls getChatModel on each chat separately and buckets the errors. Shows whether the breakage is universal or shape-specific (group vs private, @lid vs @c.us). [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_chats_safe
tools.description: List chats (resilient): Reads the chat collection directly and maps fields by hand, skipping the library’s getChatModel. Works even while chats_all is broken. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_diag_profile_pic
tools.description: Trace profile picture failure: Calls the profile-picture path directly to surface the real error behind the minified one. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_patch_apply
tools.description: Apply compatibility patch: Guards Msg.get / Msg.getMessagesById against undefined ids, fixing getChatModel on WhatsApp Web 2.3000.1046+. Idempotent.

tools.name: whatsapp_patch_verify
tools.description: Verify compatibility patch: Runs the library getChatModel over a sample of chats and reports how many now succeed. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_diag_msg_key
tools.description: Dump raw message key shape: Reads recent messages straight from the Msg collection and reports the exact structure of their id, so the correct serialization is visible rather than inferred. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_diag_msg_lookup
tools.description: Find a working message id: Takes the newest message and tries each candidate id string against the store, reporting which form actually resolves. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_session_status
tools.description: Check WhatsApp sign-in status: whether the account is linked and usable, or waiting for a QR scan, connecting, or disconnected. Works even when nothing is linked, so call this FIRST whenever a WhatsApp tool fails — it tells you whether the problem is sign-in or something else. If it reports "awaiting_scan", call whatsapp_link_start. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_link_start
tools.description: Sign in to WhatsApp: opens a page in the browser showing a QR code for the user to scan with their phone, and also returns the same code as ASCII art for headless use. THIS DOES NOT WAIT. Show the user the link, tell them to scan, and then ASK THEM TO REPLY WHEN THEY ARE DONE. When they say so, call whatsapp_session_status to confirm. Never poll or loop waiting for the scan. Returns immediately if the account is already linked.

tools.name: whatsapp_link_reset
tools.description: Forget the stored sign-in: deletes this machine's saved WhatsApp session so the next whatsapp_link_start produces a fresh QR. Use it when the stored session is broken or expired, or to link a different phone number. The device may stay listed under Linked Devices on the phone until WhatsApp expires it — remove it there too for a clean break. Ask the user before calling this. [DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone]

tools.name: whatsapp_pacing_status
tools.description: Check send pacing budget: reports how many messages have been sent recently and how much of the hourly, daily and new-chat ceilings remains. Call this before sending in bulk. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_license_status
tools.description: Check the OtterBridge licence: which tools this build is entitled to run, and until when. Call this FIRST whenever WhatsApp tools are missing or refuse to run — it distinguishes an expired or unlicensed build from a sign-in problem. Also call it after the user says they have approved a sign-in in the browser. Report its `message` to the user verbatim; it is written for them, not for you. [Read-only.]

tools.name: whatsapp_license_sign_in
tools.description: Sign in to an OtterBridge account to license this machine: opens a page in the browser where the user approves the sign-in, and returns the same link and a short code in case it did not open. THIS DOES NOT WAIT. Show the user the link and the code, tell them to approve, and then ASK THEM TO REPLY WHEN THEY ARE DONE. When they say so, call whatsapp_license_status to confirm. Never poll or loop. New accounts get a free trial automatically. For a headless machine with a licence key, use whatsapp_license_activate instead.

tools.name: whatsapp_license_activate
tools.description: Activate an OtterBridge licence key on this machine (keys look like OB-WA-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). For headless machines and CI, or when the user has been issued a key; most users should sign in with whatsapp_license_sign_in instead. Ask the user for the key — never guess one. The key can also be set once in the extension settings ("Licence key") or as the OTTERBRIDGE_LICENSE_KEY environment variable.

tools.name: whatsapp_license_sign_out
tools.description: Sign this machine out of its OtterBridge licence and free its seat, so another machine can use the account or key. WhatsApp itself stays linked. After this, only the read-only tools remain until someone signs in again. Ask the user before calling this.
